# Experten: "Det stör mig med AI-uppgången"

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-08-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

DI's Kort och Lång discusses a Swedish market that has fallen eight days in a row on small moves, while US stocks hit new records despite 30-year Treasury yields at their highest since 2001. Ulf Pettersson says Nvidia's creative chip-financing schemes (chips as loan collateral, a financing pool with BlackRock) are a bubble warning sign reminiscent of 2000 and 2008. The hosts review Q2 reports: they like Boozt, Storskogen, Revolution Race (after its drop) and Embracer, and are cautious on Björn Borg, SBB and AstraZeneca.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BOOZT — Boozt | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Growth momentum back, Denmark and female customers returning, buybacks, inventory built for a strong H2. Julia finds the 6% drop odd.

#### Reasoning

Host Julia Forsberg Thålin: the adjusted operating result was very strong, and the reported miss comes from share-based pay. Weak cash flow reflects inventory built ahead of a key Q4. More sales on the Boozt site than on the lower-margin outlet. The drop looks like profit-taking after a strong run.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak Q4 peak season
- inventory build fails to convert to sales
- growth momentum stalls

> *"Jag tror ändå att Boozt är intressant här framåt för att de verkar ha hittat tillbaka sitt tillväxtmomentum."*

---

### 🟢 RVRC — Revolution Race | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Julia sees a good buying opportunity after the drop on the acquisition strategy (I can I will); Ulf notes the low valuation and net cash.

#### Reasoning

Both hosts like the I can I will deal and CEO Fischbein. Net cash means EV is below market cap, and the company is shareholder-friendly. Risks: growth keeps slowing, Germany drags and the CEO hints at no big rebound for the core brand. Growth must be watched next quarter.

#### Sell Triggers

- too many quarters without growth
- continued weakness in Germany
- acquisition integration fails

> *"Det här kanske ändå gav ett ganska fint köpläge. I alla fall om man tror på deras förvärvsresa och det gör väl jag."*

---

### 🟢 STOR-B — Storskogen | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

P/E ~10 with no growth priced in, debt reduced to 2.4x EBITDA, acquisitions set to restart, Swedish consumer exposure.

#### Reasoning

Host Ulf Pettersson: the valuation implies roughly 10% a year even with zero growth. Deleveraging frees cash flow for acquisitions, which should add acquired growth on top of 5% organic. Beauty and hair care is now about 3bn SEK and a growth segment. Recovering Swedish consumer demand is a tailwind.

#### Sell Triggers

- leverage rises significantly
- acquisitions fail to materialize
- Swedish consumer recovery stalls

> *"Det är ett bolag som man mycket väl kan köpa på den här kursnivån."*

---

### 🟠 EMBRAC-B — Embracer | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Strong Q1 with 33% organic growth, on track for its cash EBIT target; could be rewarded more if it continues.

#### Reasoning

Ulf: the Q1 profit improvement, if repeated, puts cash EBIT at 1.1bn, above the 1bn target. Management won't raise guidance yet. Key game releases later in the fiscal year are decisive.

#### Sell Triggers

- delays to key game releases
- cash EBIT target missed

> *"Men jättebra rapport och belönades och kan nog belönas ännu mer om det fortsätter så här."*

---

### 🟠 BORG — Björn Borg | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

First sales decline in 26 quarters, key categories fell; hosts nervous about the growth story.

#### Reasoning

Hosts: the sales drop is only partly explained by timing effects, and H1 was down overall. Profit rose on higher-margin own e-commerce. The energetic CEO has changed management in some regions, so a recovery is possible, but they are cautious.

#### Sell Triggers

- another quarter of declining sales
- underwear category keeps falling

> *"Lite nervös blir man väl ändå när man ser de här siffrorna."*

---

### 🟡 AZN — AstraZeneca | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Julia is neutral: she liked the company but the defensive Bristol Myers attempt raises doubts about its pipeline.

#### Reasoning

The reported defensive merger raises questions about how confident AZ is in its portfolio. It was reportedly dropped because of the share-price reaction, which reflects poorly on leadership. The stock has recovered part of the fall.

#### Sell Triggers

- renewed large defensive M&A
- pipeline disappointments
- CEO departure

> *"Jag är nog lite neutral just nu."*

---

### ⛔ SBB-B — SBB | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Sudden CEO exit on board initiative sends a dramatic signal; deals afterwards resemble old SBB practice.

#### Reasoning

Ulf: Sönnes won back market trust by cutting debt. His abrupt departure and the next day's purchase of listed shares below NAV, booked at NAV, look like SBB's old practices. The market cut the stock, which Ulf understands.

> *"Styrelseordförande säger att det är ett odramatiskt vd-byte men jag tycker det skickar signaler om att det är ganska dramatiskt."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Chip-backed loans and financing pools seen as a warning sign of an AI bubble.

#### Reasoning

Ulf compares this to telecom 3G financing in 2000 and CDOs in 2008: excessive financial creativity often precedes a turn. Chips are poor collateral because prices fall fast, and AI models may not build moats. Not an outright sell, but a warning signal to keep an eye on.

#### Sell Triggers

- further vendor-financing schemes
- falling chip prices

> *"Så en liten varningssignalsbubbla tycker jag det är."*

---
